gloss: off the mark; wrong guess; irrelevant

definitions.gloss: off the mark; wrong guess; irrelevant; wide of the mark
definitions.explanation: A guess, estimate, or response that completely misses the point or is far from the correct answer.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見当外|けんとうはず}れだった。
examples.english: That prediction was off the mark.

examples.japanese: {見当外|けんとうはず}れな⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目星|めぼし}→目星：15941_meboshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、まったく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見当外|けんとうはず}れだった。
examples.english: I thought I had identified the culprit, but I was completely wrong.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{見当|けんとう}→見当：02795_kentou⟧ (guess/estimate) + ⟦{外|はず}れ→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧ (miss/off-target). Functions both as a noun and as a na-adjective modifier ({見当外|けんとうはず}れな). The word ⟦{見当|けんとう}→見当：02795_kentou⟧ itself comes from {見|み}{当|あ}て (aim/sight), so {見当外|けんとうはず}れ literally means "having missed one's aim."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見当外|けんとうはず}れな⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧: an off-the-mark answer
- {見当外|けんとうはず}れな⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧: misguided criticism
- まったく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見当外|けんとうはず}れ: completely off the mark
- {見当外|けんとうはず}れ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧だ: couldn't be more wrong

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{的外|まとはず}れ→的外れ：16719_matohazure⟧: off the mark; irrelevant — very close synonym; ⟦{的|まと}→的：19356_mato⟧ (target) emphasizes missing the point even more directly
- ⟦{見当違|けんとうちが}い→見当違い：18771_kentouchigai⟧: mistaken; wrong guess — essentially the same meaning with ⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧ instead of ⟦{外|はず}れ→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧
- ⟦{筋違|すじちが}い→筋違い：21040_sujichigai⟧: misdirected; barking up the wrong tree — the logic or reasoning itself is on the wrong track
